description: This file defines the Manufacturer class, which is a serializable Java object representing a manufacturer entity in the web application's admin catalog module. It encapsulates manufacturer details, descriptions, images, and order information, acting as a data transfer object or entity in the Spring Framework context.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: A Java bean class used in the web layer to manage manufacturer data, including descriptions, images, and associated manufacturer entity.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the uploaded image file as a MultipartFile object.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Returns the ProductImage object associated with this manufacturer.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Returns the wrapped core Manufacturer entity.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of ManufacturerDescription objects.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of ManufacturerDescription objects.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order integer for sorting or display purposes.
